text:
maria_fin: Quick heads up — discovered ~$12.4k of May GPU spend currently attributed to `sandbox-team` that should be split 70/30 between Platform and Search based on the Feb commit. Need retroactive reallocation and a billing backfill. Can Platform approve the shift? :eyes:

tom_ops: Do we have a clear list of affected runs/instances? I can queue a reprocess but need the filter keys.

maria_fin: Yes, short list attached below (sample). Full CSV uploaded to GCS: gs://billing-backfills/2024-05-gpu-alloc-suspects.csv

maria_fin: Sample rows:
```
instance_id,usage_hours,orig_team,new_split
gpu-rt-121,34.5,sandbox-team,platform:0.7;search:0.3
gke-prod-543,12.0,sandbox-team,platform:0.7;search:0.3
```

aditya_dev: quick check — these were from a tag migration that happened 2024-05-09 where some instances kept the old `team=sandbox` label. We fixed the mutating webhook but looks like historical ingestion didn't pick the later patch. Logs show a lot of `missing team_tag` events on 2024-05-09..11.

aditya_dev: commands I ran: `kubectl logs deploy/billing-ingest -n infra | grep "missing team_tag" | sed -n '1,50p'` — got ~290 hits spanning the window.

maria_fin: Thanks. Finance side asks: what will the customer-visible impact be? We want to avoid unexpected invoice credits without approvals. Estimated customer-facing delta = $0 (internal reallocation only). Total internal chargeback shift = $12,395.20.

sophia_accounts: Need two approvals before we reprocess: (1) Platform lead sign-off on split (70/30) and (2) Product owner for Search to accept retro attribution. cc @platform-lead @search-pm. Also need audit note for the reallocation.

tom_ops: I can queue the backfill once approvals are here. Suggested job: `python infra/tools/reprocess_alloc.py --gcs gs://billing-backfills/2024-05-gpu-alloc-suspects.csv --apply --note "retro split per Feb commit"`

billing-bot: Billing pipeline — reprocess job queued (#4321) by tom_ops. ETA 30m. Will produce output CSV to gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-05-realloc-4321.csv

maria_fin: tagging expected outputs in the ledger PR for traceability. Will open PR with before/after ledger rows and the audit rationale.

sophia_accounts: Approved from Accounts perspective pending Platform + Search PM sign-off. Also please include the cost-center codes: PLATFORM-CORE, SEARCH-TEAM for the ledger entries.

tom_ops: Platform lead verbally okayed 70/30 (DMs). queued the job, tracking job #4321. Will post results when complete.

aditya_dev: quick note — we should add a one-off rule in billing-ingest to remap any `team=sandbox` with `created_at < 2024-05-10` to the Feb mapping to avoid reoccurrence during re-ingest. Patch suggestion: small transform in `transforms/team_remap.py`.

maria_fin: Perfect. After job completes I'll open the PR and route for finance review + sign-off. Thanks everyone :pray:

billing-bot: Job #4321 completed. Summary: 18 instances adjusted, total reallocated = $12,395.20. Output: gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-05-realloc-4321.csv

sophia_accounts: Received. Please attach the ledger PR number and I'll approve the accounting entries.

maria_fin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledger/pull/289 — includes before/after, audit note, and mapping file. tagging @sophia_accounts for approval.

sophia_accounts: Approved and recorded. Closing the loop — I added a line to our monthly finance notes.

maria_fin: Closing thread — will follow up if any downstream anomalies show up. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
